title: PlatformConfig
description: Schema for a single platform configuration file in config/platforms/.

display_name.description: Human-readable platform name shown in error messages.

char_limit.description: Maximum post character count after link substitution.

link_char_cost.description: Fixed character cost per URL (e.g. 23 for t.co). null means URLs counted at actual length.

hashtag_limit.description: Hard maximum number of hashtags. null means no enforced limit.

hashtag_warn_above.description: Issue a warning when hashtag count exceeds this. null means no warning threshold.

links_clickable.description: Whether links in post body are rendered as clickable hyperlinks.

aliases.description: All input strings (lowercase) that should map to this platform (includes platform_id itself).

images_and_video_exclusive.description: True if a post cannot mix images and video in the same post.

min_image_width_px.description: Minimum image width in pixels. null means no enforced minimum. PLACEHOLDER — verify with platform docs.

min_image_height_px.description: Minimum image height in pixels. null means no enforced minimum. PLACEHOLDER — verify with platform docs.

max_image_width_px.description: Maximum image width in pixels. null means no enforced maximum. PLACEHOLDER — verify with platform docs.

max_image_height_px.description: Maximum image height in pixels. null means no enforced maximum. PLACEHOLDER — verify with platform docs.

scheduling.description: Optional platform-specific scheduling hints. PLACEHOLDER — extend when scheduling rules diverge per platform.

_notes.description: Free-text notes, caveats, or TODO items for this platform file.
